tasks.title: Move ribbon tabs into the toolbar top as a 28px strip (OO internal structure)
tasks.accept: export PATH="/home/weiss/.bun/bin:/home/weiss/.local/share/pnpm:/home/weiss/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && node --check apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/editor.js && TL=$(grep -n '<header id="toolbar"' apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html | head -1 | cut -d: -f1) && FT=$(grep -n 'class="ribbon-tab"' apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html | head -1 | cut -d: -f1) && [ -n "$TL" ] && [ -n "$FT" ] && [ "$TL" -lt "$FT" ] && grep -q '\.toolbar \.ribbon-tab\|tab-strip' apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/style.css && grep -qE 'height: 28px' apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/style.css
tasks.acceptance_prose:
ONLYOFFICE REFERENCE (measured 2026-10-05 from the OO rig): OO #toolbar = 112px made of a 28px tab-strip row (box-tabs) at the top PLUS an 84px control row below. The ribbon tab buttons live INSIDE the toolbar in OO.

WO CURRENT STATE (the deployed vanilla editor apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg): the ribbon tabs are 10 <button class="ribbon-tab" data-tab=... role="tab" style="--qa-x: <px>"> elements in index.html ~lines 170-178, INSIDE <nav id="menu-bar">, positioned absolutely via style.css rule ".menu-bar .ribbon-tab { position: absolute; left: var(--qa-x); top: 50%; ... }" (~line 200). The #toolbar header (index.html ~line 203) starts directly with the control rows (.ribbon-page). So WO's toolbar lacks the top row OO has.

GOAL: mirror OO's internal toolbar structure so the chrome pixel gate's top bands (currently ~8% over y0-54) converge:
1. index.html: MOVE the ten ribbon-tab buttons from #menu-bar into #toolbar, placed BEFORE the .ribbon-page control rows, forming a top 28px tab strip. Keep every tab's data-tab value, role="tab", aria-selected, the style="--qa-x: <px>" positions, and the label text unchanged. The File menu (btn-file + file-menu ul) and the rest of #menu-bar stay where they are.
2. style.css: retarget the tab-positioning rule from ".menu-bar .ribbon-tab" to ".toolbar .ribbon-tab" (or introduce the strip via a wrapper/rule such that the tabs render as a 28px-high row pinned to the top of #toolbar, x placed by var(--qa-x), 3px active underline kept). The toolbar total height must stay 112px; the control rows must render in the remaining ~84px below the strip (they already do at 46px-tall controls).
3. editor.js: the tab activation code queries '.ribbon-tab' and '.ribbon-page' by class (lines ~5219-5251) and is location-agnostic - keep it working exactly as before (click toggles aria-selected on tabs and the matching .ribbon-page active class). Do not change handlers, data-tab values, or shortcuts.
HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT rename any tab data-tab value, any control id, or any data-cmd value. Do NOT remove or hide any control. Do NOT touch files outside apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg.
- Keep the 3px underline and active-state behavior. Keep aria-labels/data-i18n attributes.
- The pixel/geometry gates re-run after merge; the accept below proves the structural move only (worktree has no docserver). Commit on the worktree branch with a conventional message instead of running servers.

Worktree layout: you are at the monorepo root; paths are relative to it. Read index.html lines 165-215 and style.css lines 195-215 and 120-160 before editing; the menu-bar File trigger and the titlebar must not move.
